title: 第19章 偶遇流民
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
五天后。

    陆舟一行人已经快要接近云州州城了。

    整个云州，共有五县之地，相较于茶州，小了很多。

    概因古越各个小国频繁侵扰，今日占一乡，明日掠一县……

    但即便只剩五县，所处位置依旧极为分散。

    正因为分散，才导致州城的优势辐射不到其他县城。

    对此，大周自然是不管不顾，任由云州自生自灭。

    陆舟也是切身实地地感受到了这片土地的惨状。

    他一路沉默不语，眼底渐渐泛起几分沉郁。

    若再按照这个情况发展下去，整个云州不但会人口流失，甚至仍有被古越小国继续侵占的可能。

    只因大周的敌人，可不止北方蛮子和西边大夏。

    这些看似俯首称臣的古越小国，可一直都有着狼子野心，只等一个大周衰败的契机。

    想到这，他又看了眼系统。

    经过几日的积累，系统的余额已经有四百多万了。

    这系统，是他发展云州的关键！

    就在这时，马车突然停了。

    陆舟掀开车帘，正好撞见前方官道正黑压压聚集了上百名衣衫褴褛的流民。

    男女老少皆有，个个面黄肌瘦，很是凄惨。

    队伍里，一众甲士纷纷握紧兵刃，神色戒备地望向这群来路不明的流民，生怕闹出什么乱子。

    不过这群流民似乎也对众人无比畏惧，看着那兵刃，皆是吓得连连后退，神色惶恐不安地让开了官道，然后继续朝着北方前行。

    见状，陆舟眸光微闪，当即唤来周川，让其去询问这群流民的来历。

    毕竟这是他云州的百姓，既然遇到，总得了解了解。

    兴许，还能得到一些自己不曾知晓的消息。

    没过多久，周川就回来了。

    “王爷，这群人从黎平县逃难出来的，正打算去茶州！”他简略禀报道。

    黎平县是云州最北的一个县城，相对其他四县，更为安全稳定。

    怎么会出现一大批人逃难呢？

    陆舟眸光一沉，接下令：“拦住他们！”

    这可是他云州的百姓，若都去了茶州，那自己不就白白损失了上百两白银？

    周川得令，当即命令甲士拦住流民的去路。

    突然的变故，让前方刘傲脸色更冷。

    他本就因一群流民而心烦意乱，眼下见到周川竟然敢私自指挥士兵，当即怒斥：“周川，你想找死吗？敢不听本将军命令，擅自调动军队？”

    “是本王下令的！”

    这时，陆舟的声音陡然响起。

    他从马车上下来，直视着刘傲，面无表情，毫无惧色。

    距离六品顶级武者只差一步之遥的他，已经不怕对方了。

    刘傲挑眉。
content_en:
Five days later.

    Lu Zhou and his party were almost approaching the city of Yunzhou.

    There are five counties in the entire Yunzhou, which is much smaller than Chazhou.

    Probably due to the frequent intrusions from various small countries in ancient Yue, one day they occupied a township, and tomorrow they plundered a county...

    But even if there are only five counties left, their locations are still extremely scattered.

    It is precisely because of the dispersion that the advantages of the prefecture cannot radiate to other counties.

    Dazhou naturally ignored this and allowed Yunzhou to fend for itself.

    Lu Zhou also felt the tragedy of this land firsthand.

    He was silent all the way, and his eyes gradually became a bit gloomy.

    If this situation continues to develop, the entire Yunzhou will not only lose its population, but may even be continued to be occupied by the small ancient Yue country.

    Just because the enemies of the Zhou Dynasty were not just the barbarians in the north and Daxia in the west.

    These small ancient Yue countries that seemed to be submissive had always had wolfish ambitions and were just waiting for an opportunity for the decline of the Great Zhou Dynasty.

    Thinking of this, he looked at the system again.

    After several days of accumulation, the balance of the system already exceeds four million.

    This system is the key to his development of Yunzhou!

    At this moment, the carriage suddenly stopped.

    Lu Zhou opened the car curtain and happened to see hundreds of ragged refugees gathered in the dark official road ahead.

    There are men, women, old and young, all of them are sallow and thin, and they are very miserable.

    In the team, all the soldiers clenched their swords and looked at the group of unknown refugees with wary expressions, for fear of causing any trouble.

    However, this group of refugees also seemed to be extremely afraid of everyone. Looking at the weapons, they were all frightened and backed away. They gave way to the official road with panic and uneasiness, and then continued to move towards the north.

    Upon seeing this, Lu Zhou's eyes flashed slightly, and he immediately called Zhou Chuan to ask him about the origins of this group of refugees.

    After all, these are the people of Yunzhou. Since they meet them, they must understand them.

    Maybe, you can also get some news that you didn't know before.

    Not long after, Zhou Chuan came back.

    "Your Majesty, these people who escaped from Liping County are planning to go to Chazhou!" he reported briefly.

    Liping County is the northernmost county in Yunzhou and is safer and more stable than the other four counties.

    How could there be a large number of people fleeing?

    Lu Zhou's eyes darkened and he took the order: "Stop them!"

    These were the people of his Yunzhou state. If they all went to Chazhou, wouldn't he have lost hundreds of taels of silver in vain?

    Zhou Chuan received the order and immediately ordered the soldiers to block the way of the refugees.

    The sudden change made Liu Ao's face in the front look even colder.

    He was already upset by a group of refugees, but when he saw Zhou Chuan dare to command the soldiers privately, he immediately angrily shouted: "Zhou Chuan, do you want to die? Dare you disobey my general's orders and mobilize the troops without authorization?"

    "This is the king's order!"

    At this time, Lu Zhou's voice suddenly sounded.

    He got off the carriage and looked directly at Liu Ao, expressionless and without fear.

    He was only one step away from being a top sixth-grade warrior, and he was no longer afraid of the opponent.

    Liu Ao raised his eyebrows.
